title: Admin, Permissions and Audit
case_ids_frozen_by: P17 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P17-Txxx identifiers

inherited_authorities: P06 entitlement resolver plus ownership/DNS/HTTPS/risk axes and seven-day normal downgrade grace
P09 mandatory ClamAV quarantine/scan/publish fail-closed authority
P12 Workspace membership/RBAC and notification core/read-state/dedupe/deep-link authority
P14 support ticket/mail authority; ticket mutation is request/evidence only and never entitlement
P15 customer authentication/session/CSRF/Origin/rate/OAuth authority and shared security primitives
P16 destination/domain risk and abuse authority including exact-current fail-closed actions and redaction
capability_contract.scope: P17 closes administrator access/permissions/operations/audit, domain-entitlement Admin governance, API-key and generic outbound-webhook contributions without re-owning predecessor business/security authorities or P18/P19/P20-P22 release work.

rules: No authenticated-admin or superuser boolean substitutes for a dedicated server permission decision.
tickets.manage never implies domains.entitlements.manage.
domains.manage never implies domains.risk.manage or domains.entitlements.manage.
security.manage never implies admins.manage, operations.manage or domains.entitlements.manage.
Frontend navigation visibility never substitutes for server authorization.
Workspace API-key and webhook mutation require dedicated server-side Workspace role/capability checks and cannot weaken P12 tenant/RBAC.
All Workspace/Admin routes are no-store/noindex and absent from sitemaps.
Page-Level IA is the route/path authority; no legacy alias or unregistered Admin/Workspace page may be invented.
IA family dependencies are not misrepresented as IA-exact methods; P17 implementation methods are separately labeled.
Inherited P09/P13/P14/P15/P16 surfaces remain predecessor-owned except for the explicit P17 governance contribution.
Manual approval expires_at is required and later than starts_at.
Ticket creation/reply/close never grants entitlement.
P06/P13 source precedence/domain_limit/grace remain authoritative.
P16 domain-risk/abuse safety suspension remains independent and can block otherwise valid entitlement.
Administrator identity and permission lifecycle is separate from customer account and Workspace membership authority.
TOTP material is never exposed after enrollment proof.
Session rotation/revocation, CSRF, Origin and rate controls are server-side.
High-risk actions require explicit permission and accountable reason/impact confirmation where applicable.
Raw API-key secret is returned exactly once and is not recoverable from storage.
Each key is Workspace-bound, scope-bound, expiry-aware and server-rate-limited.
Rotation atomically invalidates old secret authority; revoke/expiry take effect immediately.
Logs/audit/evidence contain key ID/prefix metadata only, never raw secret.
Generic outbound webhooks are distinct from P13 payment callbacks.
Endpoint ownership and Workspace authorization are server-authoritative.
Signing uses reviewed canonical delivery ID/timestamp/body semantics; secrets are stored safely and rotation invalidates old signing authority.
Delivery validates scheme, hostname and every resolved/connected address before connect and after every redirect; loopback/private/link-local/metadata/reserved/mixed/rebound destinations fail closed.
Retry/backoff is bounded, durable and idempotent; disable stops delivery authority and restart recovery cannot duplicate authoritative state.
No ninth production daemon: delivery uses fixed SVC-OPS-MONITOR.
Service restart/requeue requires operations.manage, reason/impact confirmation and immutable audit.
Audit query is append-only authority; ordinary API cannot mutate/delete history.
Passwords, sessions/tokens, OAuth/payment/webhook/API-key secrets, DB credentials, ClamAV private paths and user content are prohibited from audit/log evidence.
Use inherited Admin/Workspace shells and Design System only.
Canonical desktop/tablet/mobile plus 320 CSS px reflow, keyboard/focus/name-role-value and reduced-motion evidence are required where applicable.
High-risk actions have visible triggers and reason/impact confirmation; persistent failure/result is not toast-only.
Direct URL/API authorization is re-evaluated server-side.

environment_contract.mysql: Real MySQL 8.x for administrator/role/permission/session, entitlement decisions, API-key/webhook state, operations/audit and settings evidence.
environment_contract.redis: Real Redis for rate/idempotency/lease/short-lived coordination where implemented; durable authority remains MySQL.
environment_contract.platformapi: Real native Go platformapi for Workspace/Admin APIs and server authorization.
environment_contract.operationsmonitor: Fixed SVC-OPS-MONITOR handles webhook delivery and P17 operational job contributions; no ninth daemon.
environment_contract.webhook_fixture: Deterministic local DNS/HTTP fixtures exercise signing, retry, redirect, SSRF and DNS-rebinding paths without probing external private networks.
environment_contract.browser: Built Workspace/Admin surfaces with real local APIs and server session/RBAC authority.

closure.scope_rule: P17 closes only its administrator/access/operations/audit/domain-entitlement-governance/API-key/webhook and frozen shared contributions. P18/P19 and release-wide P20-P22 remain later-owned.

cases.name: Durable administrator, role and permission authority
cases.oracle: Administrator identities, role assignments and explicit permission grants are durable, server-authoritative, auditable and separate from customer Workspace RBAC.

cases.name: Administrator login, session, TOTP, lock and rate authority
cases.oracle: Admin login enforces server session lifecycle, TOTP, lock/rate, CSRF/Origin and secret-safe behavior.

cases.name: Permission catalog and independent authorization
cases.oracle: Dedicated permissions are server-evaluated and unrelated authority never implies another.

cases.name: Administrator MFA and session governance
cases.oracle: MFA/session list/revoke is actor-bound, replay-safe and auditable; revoked sessions lose authority immediately.

cases.name: High-risk reason, idempotency, correlation and immutable audit
cases.oracle: High-risk mutation records required reason, idempotency/correlation and immutable secret-safe before/after audit.

cases.name: Domain-entitlement queue/detail and dedicated permission
cases.oracle: Queue/detail consume P06/P13/P14 authority and require domains.entitlements.manage independently.

cases.name: Manual entitlement approve and deny authority
cases.oracle: Approve creates only structured manual_approval through inherited resolver; deny grants nothing; both are fully auditable.

cases.name: Entitlement suspend, revoke, restore and ticket-manager denial
cases.oracle: Suspend/revoke immediate; restore needs current evidence; tickets.manage alone never decides entitlement.

cases.name: Preserve entitlement, grace and domain safety semantics
cases.oracle: P06/P13 source precedence/domain_limit/grace and P16 safety suspension remain authoritative and conjunctive.

cases.name: Administrator users and workspaces governance
cases.oracle: User/workspace governance requires dedicated permission, safe enumeration, accountable reason and audit.

cases.name: Cross-resource governance permission separation
cases.oracle: Links/domains/QR/Text/Bio actions enforce dedicated resource permissions without cross-authority escalation.

cases.name: Files administrator actions preserve mandatory ClamAV
cases.oracle: File quarantine/rescan/restore/delete reuses P09 state and cannot bypass ClamAV fail-closed authority.

cases.name: Trust, domain-risk and abuse governance inherits P16
cases.oracle: P17 consumes P16 permissions/actions without weakening exact-current risk, fail-closed or provider-redaction rules.

cases.name: Operations jobs inspect and requeue authority
cases.oracle: Job inspect/requeue requires operations.manage, bounded idempotency/correlation and audit.

cases.name: Eight-service health and restart governance
cases.oracle: Exactly eight service identities; restart requires operations.manage, reason/impact confirmation and audit; no ninth daemon.

cases.name: General settings and brand assets governance
cases.oracle: settings.manage governs reviewed settings/assets with validation/conflict and secret masking.

cases.name: Official-domain lifecycle and destination-risk parity
cases.oracle: Official hosts require domains.manage and preserve P05/P16 risk parity across disable/default/HTTPS transitions.

cases.name: Turnstile administrator configuration
cases.oracle: settings.manage governs bot protection; secrets masked and incomplete/provider-error states preserve fail-closed protection.

cases.name: Announcement lifecycle governance
cases.oracle: content.manage governs draft/scheduled/published/archived states, validation, scope, cache and audit.

cases.name: Immutable audit query and redaction
cases.oracle: Authorized audit query exposes accountable fields while secrets/raw tokens/provider evidence remain redacted and history immutable.

cases.name: P17 notification producer contribution
cases.oracle: P17 events reuse P12 notification core/dedupe/safe deep links and never become authorization/audit authority.

cases.name: API-key create, scope and secret-once
cases.oracle: Workspace-authorized key creation constrains scope, stores no recoverable raw secret and discloses it once.

cases.name: API-key rotation, revocation, expiry and rate
cases.oracle: Rotation invalidates old secret; revoke/expiry immediate; scope/rate server-enforced and lifecycle audited.

cases.name: API-key tenant and RBAC isolation
cases.oracle: Cross-Workspace/insufficient-role API-key calls fail without existence leakage; frontend is not authority.

cases.name: Outbound-webhook ownership and configuration
cases.oracle: Generic webhook endpoints are Workspace-owned, validated, payment-callback-independent and tenant-authorized.

cases.name: Outbound-webhook signing and secret rotation
cases.oracle: Deliveries use reviewed signatures; secret storage/one-time display/rotation are atomic and old authority invalidates.

cases.name: Outbound-webhook SSRF and DNS-rebinding defense
cases.oracle: Every DNS/connect/redirect hop rejects private/link-local/metadata/reserved/mixed/rebound destinations fail closed.

cases.name: Outbound-webhook retry, idempotency and disable
cases.oracle: Durable bounded retry/backoff/idempotency and disable/restart recovery cannot duplicate authoritative state.

cases.name: Outbound-webhook tenant/RBAC, audit and redaction
cases.oracle: Delivery inspection/retry/disable remains tenant-authorized and evidence excludes raw webhook secrets and unnecessary PII.

cases.name: Admin Access real browser authority
cases.oracle: Admin login/TOTP/administrators/roles/sessions are route-backed, authorized, responsive/accessibility compliant and accountable.

cases.name: Admin governance and domain-entitlement browser authority
cases.oracle: Governance/domain-entitlement routes cover frozen states, permission denials and high-risk confirmations without unsafe evidence.

cases.name: Workspace API-key and webhook browser authority
cases.oracle: /app/api-keys and /app/webhooks cover frozen lifecycle/forbidden/error states with direct-route RBAC and safe secrets.

cases.name: Operations, Audit and Platform browser authority
cases.oracle: Overview/jobs/services/audit/general/official-domains/Turnstile/announcements cover applicable degradation/stale/error/destructive states and permission boundaries.

cases.name: Exact-head evidence coherence
cases.oracle: P17-T001..T033 evidence is complete, redacted, hashed, producer-coherent and one-head bound; mixed-head/unsafe evidence fails.

cases.name: Accountable signed exact-head closure
cases.oracle: Review-only signed child reruns all cases and affected matrix; P0/P1/DECISION REQUIRED zero and merge_authoritative=true.
